backrooms.description: Backrooms: The Endless Halls is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. On your own or with friends, you’ll dive into an unknown world where everything will seem familiar to you, yet at the same time frightening and very confusing. Try to make it out alive, if that’s even possible...
